title: Cat apron, really?
text:
While my cats love the 2 catnip toys and 1 string toy they aren’t too wild about freeze dried treats and certainly don’t want anything to do with the loud and crinkly cat apron. I’m pretty sure cats do not like to be be dressed up and this ultimately seems like a throw away item no one will ever use. Based on that and my cats possible catnip allergy I will be canceling the subscription.

I think this is a good idea but needs more work. I can easily spend less money to get the same items. That being said, cats are jerks and hard to please so kudos for trying.
label: neutral
